desc:
🏴‍☠️ Welcome to One Piece Arena!

Jump into fast-paced battles and fight with powers inspired by One Piece. Defeat other players to earn Yen, unlock new characters, and find the moveset that fits your fighting style.

🔥 Game Features
• 15 playable characters, each with a unique moveset
• Fast-paced arena combat
• Earn Yen by fighting and spend it to unlock characters
• More characters and updates coming soon

🎮 Supported Devices
PC, Mobile, Tablet, Xbox, and PlayStation

⭐ Like and favorite the game for more updates!

⚠️ Rules
No exploiting
